It was all because of our world, because of[XENO:n ]
Giant God, that this city was devastated.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]Now I understand why Egil would want[XENO:n ]
to stop the Giant God from reawakening.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT4 ]I get it too, but how's killing any of us[XENO:n ]
going to solve his problem?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Precisely.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

What happened to the Machina was a tragedy,[XENO:n ]
but we cannot forgive the Mechon attack on Giant God.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
What worries me is the Monado that the Giant God used.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

It's no different from how[XENO:n ]
the legends describe, but still...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
It must hold a deadly power.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]But you have used it wisely, Shulk.[XENO:n ]
It has not overwhelmed you as it did me.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]He's right! If you hadn't been using the Monado,[XENO:n ]
we wouldn't have lasted five minutes.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
But it was Zanza who bestowed this sword upon me.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

However, it is not Zanza who now[XENO:n ]
wields the Monado. It is you, Shulk.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:jaw jaw=off ][XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:jaw jaw=on ][XENO:del del=this ]

That is also the reason why Meyneth[XENO:n ]
chose Fiorung as a vessel.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

So that the tragedy of he who wields the[XENO:n ]
Monado would not be repeated.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
The tragedy of he who wields the Monado?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Shulk... Believe.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

Believe in the path you have chosen[XENO:n ]
and those who walk it with you.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
Meyneth once said this of the Monado.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
The Monado is not simply a unique weapon.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

It is the light within each and every[XENO:n ]
person in this world.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT1 ]Light? What do you mean?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

It is the light of life, the will to[XENO:n ]
survive no matter what.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

Perhaps Lady Meyneth[XENO:n ]
was drawn to your light.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Beyond there lies the Meyneth Shrine.[XENO:n ]
Egil will be there.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

Is it still your intention to defeat Egil?[XENO:n ]
That has not changed?[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

We understand the history of Machine God now.[XENO:n ]
If he is willing to listen, we will try to reason with him.[XENO:wait wait=key ]
[XENO:act act=EVT_EXT10 ]But if not...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]

[XENO:act act=EVT1 ]I understand. Then if that is your[XENO:n ]
decision, so be it.[XENO:wait wait=key ]

I will try to persuade Egil one last time.[XENO:n ]
But I am prepared for his refusal.[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
Vanea...[XENO:wait wait=key ][XENO:del del=this ]
